sentences.en: I'm bothered since the strap of my backpack tore.
sentences.zh: 背包的带子破了，我挺烦恼的。

sentences.en: Hold on to the strap. The train will start to move soon.
sentences.zh: 抓紧那个带子。火车就要开动了。

sentences.en: She has this pretty lace nightgown with straps.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一件有蝴蝶结肩带的漂亮睡衣。

senses.zh: 用带捆绑；用皮条抽打；约束 -
精力旺盛地工作；受束缚
